title: Swagger API Documentation Testing
description: Build a Swagger-documented API with JSON and HTML docs, ensuring every route is properly documented with schemas.

steps.title: JSON API docs endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /api-docs.json endpoint that returns the OpenAPI/Swagger specification as JSON.
hints: Use swagger-jsdoc or build the OpenAPI spec object manually
Define basic info: title, version, description
Return the spec object as JSON

steps.title: HTML API docs endpoint
steps.description: Add a GET /api-docs endpoint that renders Swagger UI HTML page.
hints: Use swagger-ui-express to serve Swagger UI
Point the UI to the /api-docs.json spec URL

steps.title: Document all routes in Swagger
steps.description: Ensure the /api-docs.json contains paths for all documented routes.
hints: Add route annotations using JSDoc or inline OpenAPI spec
Verify /api-docs.json has a non-empty paths object
Check that each route appears in the paths

steps.title: POST route with request body schema
steps.description: Ensure the API docs include a POST route with a request body schema defined.
hints: Add a POST route documented in OpenAPI with requestBody
Include application/json content type with schema

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI(title='Test API', version='1.0.0')
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class ItemIn(BaseModel):
    name: str

class Item(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str

items = []
next_id = 1

@app.get('/items')
def list_items():
    return items

@app.post('/items', status_code=201)
def create_item(item: ItemIn):
    global next_id
    new_item = Item(id=next_id, name=item.name)
    next_id += 1
    items.append(new_item)
    return new_item
